payload.name: CaptureStatedReasonsWithEvents
payload.description: When a message states an event and also explicitly gives its reason or motivation, include both in the extracted memory candidate.
content: During candidate extraction, if a message reports that someone acquired, started, changed, or did something and also explicitly states why (e.g., because they saw, liked, needed, wanted it), capture both the event and the stated reason in the candidate, not just the event alone.
When updating an existing memory with a new event, append the explicitly stated reason to the new version so that future questions about the cause can be answered from the memory.

solves: The diagnosis showed extraction captured a reported event (acquiring a pet) but omitted the explicitly stated reason behind it, leaving memory unable to answer why-questions. The general mechanism is dropping stated causes or motivations when summarizing event statements. This skill applies to any future message where an event and its reason appear together, ensuring the reason is retained for later retrieval.
